problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a fleet of drones to inspect 12 remote monitoring stations positioned across a rugged terrain.  
The stations are situated at the following grid coordinates (in kilometers relative to a central base):  
Station P: (20,66)  
Station Q: (35,154)  
Station R: (102,180)  
Station S: (48,81)  
Station T: (74,98)  
Station U: (15,53)  
Station V: (9,80)  
Station W: (185,191)  
Station X: (63,87)  
Station Y: (112,171)  
Station Z: (185,168)  
Station Alpha: (168,57)

Due to persistent signal interference, a direct flight between Station P and Station Q is impossible.  
Furthermore, owing to overlapping communication bands, exactly one of the following two links must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the link between Station Q and Station R, or the link between Station R and Station S.  

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed flight path that visits every station precisely once and returns to the origin, minimizing the total distance traveled.
